title: Haiwaan
synopsis: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.

synopsis_lang.en: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 一名退休法官費盡心力，想保護女兒免受他昔日判刑入獄的罪犯報復。然而，當法官遇害後，一名忠於他且視力受損的男子，挺身而出，誓死捍衛法官的女兒。

cast: Saif Ali Khan, Akshay Kumar, Boman Irani
